text:
ava.marketing: quick thread — thinking about a low-risk "early-score" flow for launches: compute a very fast prediction (from form fields + utm) and tag leads as `early_score_candidate` so claim logic can prefer richer-looking records briefly. goal: fewer cold claims during spikes without touching RR weights.

ryan-sdr: is this just another prefetch? last time fields popped in and confused reps.

ava.marketing: different enough — we don’t call external enrichment first. we compute an early_score (0-100) from existing fields inline (<20ms) and flag the lead. only if the external enrichment later comes back do we reconcile into temp props. the early tag is advisory only.

sam-salesops: advisory-only sounds safer. need naming & audit so reps know what’s provisional. suggest `early_score_state` and `early_score_ts`, plus `early_score_reason`.

hs-sync-bot: heads-up: will add those HS props and include `early_score` in the HS->SF payload. no schema breaking changes.

leo-ops: sample feature flag I can toggle quickly for a canary: 
```json
{"flag":"routing.early_score.v1","canary_pct":2,"early_score_latency_ms":25,"prefer_window_ms":20000,"claim_lock_ms":35000,"reconcile_window_ms":300000}
```

claire-growth: cohort: campaign in (launch_email, webinar_q3) AND leadscore>60. start small (2%), evaluate 24h, then broaden.

ryan-sdr: what happens if the external enrich later conflicts with early_score info? reps got burned last time when company names changed.

ava.marketing: reconcile rules: external enrich writes to `temp_*` fields with `temp_ts`. UI shows a small badge "early tag"; temp fields are not auto-promoted. promotion only on rep confirm or when enrich_score>0.9. also keep an immutable audit log property `early_score_audit` with a short string.

sam-salesops: can we add a small automation: if temp fields appear after claim and enrich_score>0.95, add a task for rep to review and auto-suggest promotion? reduces manual churn.

leo-ops: metrics i'll add: `early_score_tag_rate`, `claims_preferring_early_score_pct`, `claims_with_conflict_pct`, `manual_promote_rate`, `claim_latency_p95_ms`, `rr_fairness_index`. auto-disable thresholds: rr_fairness_index degrade >10% OR claim_latency_p95 increase >20% OR claims_with_conflict_pct >4%.

claire-growth: comms: one-pager for SDRs + 2-line Slack alert. show exact HS prop names and a screenshot of the badge. also brief Sales Ops review.

hs-sync-bot: feature flag `routing.early_score.v1` created in staging; HS props staged: early_score, early_score_state, early_score_ts, temp_* namespace.

ava.marketing: ops: can you flip a 2% canary tonight at 6pm PT? we'll monitor #handoff-sla and do a 24h spike check.

leo-ops: yep — staging smoke now, prod canary 6pm PT. cadence: +5m, +30m, +2h updates. I'll post dashboards and a short rollback command in the channel.

ryan-sdr: thanks. if you include the HUD badge and the one-pager i'll brief the team in AM. small ask: make the badge wording clearly say "predictive — verify".

ava.marketing: good note, will do. check-in tomorrow 10am PT to widen/rollback. :rocket:
